news.title: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 as $800 billion AI selloff leaves crypto largely untouched
news.summary: The Magnificent Seven had their worst day since April 2025 after Alphabet and Tesla spooked investors on AI spending. Bitcoin fell less than 1%, and dogecoin led the majors lower.

news.title: Mirae plans to turn crypto exchange Korbit into something Korea hasn't seen before
news.summary: The South Korean financial giant says its Korbit – soon to be rebranded as Digital X – is just the starting point for a broader ecosystem that connects RWAs, stablecoins and digital assets.

news.title: BitMEX faces proposed class-action suit for theft, insider trading as crypto exchange shuts down
news.summary: The complaint claims BitMEX designed a system to retain customer collateral and alleges an internal desk accessed private user data during server freezes.

news.title: Bitcoin treasury companies sell up, repay debt, pivot to AI as share prices collapse
news.summary: Falling share prices, debt obligations and difficult market conditions are forcing former bitcoin accumulators to sell their holdings and restructure operations.
